bento.speed_desc: Traditional manual typing on the official portal often takes 15–20 minutes, frequently resulting in abrupt session expiry and lost work. PothikVisa validates and generates your complete Web File in milliseconds, locking in your application before timeouts can occur.

bento.resume_title: Seamless session continuity with zero lost progress
bento.resume_desc: If an official portal server interrupts your process halfway through or if you need to replace a file, you never start from zero. Our system retains your progress securely, allowing 1-click continuation with all previously verified data intact.
